nom: Drunk Elephant Ceramighty AF Eye Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry under-eyes describe the balm as absorbing well and leaving the area soft, smooth and hydrated, though a few say it did not help much or must be avoided when skin is already sensitive/irritated.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with sensitive skin or eyes report no irritation and good tolerance, while a distinct, larger group with self-described sensitive or watery eyes report burning, stinging or redness when the product migrates into the eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers identifying as mature or over 50 report smoothing of fine lines, reduced dark circles and a firmer feel around the eyes, with occasional comments of seeing no visible change.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visible softening of fine lines, crow's feet and a plumping or firming effect around the eyes; a few say they saw no difference after weeks or months of use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of comments describe strong, lasting hydration and a non-greasy feel under the eyes, with almost no dissent on this point.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with an eczema-prone eye area reports a noticeable improvement, while others describe redness or itching appearing as a reaction to the product rather than being resolved by it.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer used it to rebuild the skin barrier after retinoid use and found it moisturizing and occlusive in a good way, though the same review notes eye-stinging despite careful application.
concerns.spots: A single review reports a child breaking out in hives, puffiness and pimples after use, an isolated but notable dissenting account.
concerns.blemishes: The same isolated case above describes new pimples appearing on the face after use; no other reviewer reports blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers state the balm absorbs without leaving a greasy or oily residue; no reports of increased oiliness were found.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns if it enters eyes
Long-lasting, product goes a long way
High price relative to visible results

extraits.texte: I have dry, very sensitive skin and dark circles under my eyes. This eye cream is wonderful, smooths and moisturizes with no red chapped reaction, just love it!!

I am so pleased with this eye cream. I only apply it under my eye since it ran into my eyes when I applied it on my lid, but it has been a miracle for moisturizing and smoothing the under-eye area, where I have fine lines and signs of aging. I have tried all of the Drunk Elephant eye creams (and like all of them!), and this one makes the biggest difference. It is now my most essential eye product. And, as with all of the DE eye products, it causes no issues with my super sensitive skin and fragrance sensitivities.

You know how expensive/luxury doesnt always mean better? I spent a long time under the impression that Drunk Elephant was another "influencer product"; a product that's famous for being famous and built around internet clout. I got this eye cream as a Christmas gift, and boy, was I WRONG. I'd been looking for something to help treat the eczema patches around my eyes, and all of the moisturizers I tried would just keep it from getting worse but not make it any better. This stuff made a noticeable improvement in literally one use. I feel like a paid shill raving so hard about this product, but I was just so blown away.moisturi

i just got this for my 9 year old, she loves the serum so much and she said it makes her cheeks and face feel amazing but she broke out yesterday in hives .. eyes all puffy red and nose is covered in pimples .!!

extraits.titre: I don't understand bad reviews! Love this!!
extraits.texte: This is so moisturizing!! Makes my dry mature under eyes feel smooth and hydrated like nothing else has!! This is so good! I guess I don't get creams in my eye so havnt had it burn! I really do love this product!!!

extraits.titre: why does a protective eye cream sting so badly?
extraits.texte: I bought this myself. I thought DE would do a ceramide eye cream well. It was a decent heavy cream fow winter, but it stung my eyes so badly every application. Eye creams are supposed to be used around the eye area. It's not like I would put it IN my eyes, but you cant even get close to your lashes (or use a hudrating spray). For something designed for sensitive or mature skin and healing the skin barrier, I'm afraid this just doesn't instill confidence. You aren't supposed to burn your eyes, and I'm surprised they didn't catch that in formulation. They sure charge enough for it!
